The '''Therenor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Therenor Prime]].<ref name="SWM15" />
